title: Cloudflare Open Source AI Agent Workspace: Let Every Employee Build Custom Workflows Without Code
excerpt: Cloudflare officially launched its open-source AI agent workspace, Cloudflare OS, which runs in the browser and is embedded with a large number of customizable
content_html:
Cloudflare officially launched its open-source AI agent workspace, Cloudflare OS, which runs in the browser and is embedded with a large number of customizable micro-applications that can be shared. This platform is not a simple encapsulation of general AI tools but was entirely developed by Cloudflare's own team based on their daily needs, and has been tested internally for a long time before being open-sourced for all enterprises to use. Matthew Prince, co-founder and CEO of Cloudflare, stated that for AI to truly bring transformation to enterprises, it should not be limited to isolated environments. Enterprises should empower every employee with the ability to securely build and automate workflows.

The core advantage of Cloudflare OS lies in capturing and accumulating internal knowledge from the very first day an enterprise starts using it. Employees without professional development backgrounds can create personalized micro-applications using the company's internal knowledge base, build workflows, and collaborate and share internally, effectively avoiding loss of context information. In response to the pain point of current enterprise AI tools being too generic and lacking specific knowledge, the platform allows each team to build intelligent applications that deeply understand their business logic, rather than relying on external standardized products.

Zero-trust architecture with built-in models, giving enterprises full control over data and costs

This framework is completely open source and runs on the enterprise's own Cloudflare account, allowing enterprises to have full control over all processes, context data, and system connections, effectively avoiding being locked into closed products. Relying on the technology of Cloudflare Access, the system defaults to a zero-trust architecture, rigorously verifying every access and request, matching the security and enterprise compliance requirements.

The platform also introduced the "bring-your-own-model" feature, allowing enterprises to connect to any AI model provider through Cloudflare AI Gateway. Administrators can accurately monitor token usage and cost expenditures, and view detailed expenses by personnel, teams, and applications. Administrators can set budgets and speed limits or flexibly distribute requests based on task complexity, such as assigning routine tasks to small and efficient models, and calling cutting-edge large models when high-level reasoning is needed. Prince added that the development of Cloudflare OS was due to the lack of similar products on the market that met their needs, and now all enterprises can directly use this well-refined result after years of polishing.

content_html_zh:
Cloudflare 正式推出了其开源 AI 代理工作区 Cloudflare OS，它运行在浏览器中，并嵌入了大量可定制的可共享的微应用。 这个平台并不是对通用AI工具的简单封装，而是完全由Cloudflare自己的团队根据日常需求进行开发，并且经过了长时间的内部测试才开源给所有企业使用。 Cloudflare联合创始人兼首席执行官Matthew Prince表示，人工智能要真正为企业带来变革，不应该局限于孤立的环境。 企业应该赋予每位员工安全构建和自动化工作流程的能力。

Cloudflare OS的核心优势在于从企业开始使用它的第一天起就捕获和积累内部知识。 没有专业开发背景的员工可以利用公司内部知识库创建个性化微应用，构建工作流程，并进行内部协作和共享，有效避免上下文信息丢失。 针对当前企业AI工具过于通用、缺乏具体知识的痛点，该平台允许每个团队构建深度理解其业务逻辑的智能应用，而不是依赖外部标准化产品。

内置模型的零信任架构，让企业完全掌控数据和成本

该框架完全开源，运行在企业自己的Cloudflare账户上，让企业可以完全控制所有流程、上下文数据和系统连接，有效避免被锁定在封闭产品中。 依托Cloudflare Access的技术，系统默认采用零信任架构，严格验证每一次访问和请求，匹配安全和企业合规要求。

该平台还推出了“自带模型”功能，允许企业通过 Cloudflare AI Gateway 连接到任何 AI 模型提供商。 管理员可以准确监控代币使用情况和成本支出，并查看人员、团队和应用程序的详细支出。 管理员可以根据任务复杂程度设定预算和速度限制或灵活分配请求，例如将常规任务分配给小型高效的模型，并在需要高级推理时调用前沿的大型模型。 Prince补充道，Cloudflare OS的开发是因为市场上缺乏满足其需求的同类产品，现在所有企业都可以直接使用这个经过多年打磨的完善成果。
